title: 第2535章 猎影小队第2534章 一百五十年
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 精瘦青年再次叹息，随即脸上又露出一丝由衷的感激和自豪，
“不过，也幸好有他这尊‘过路神仙’！这一百多年，咱们猎影的任务完成率是百分百！从五级小队一路杀到一级，成了这陨神古州响当当的招牌，飞雪城当之无愧的第一！没有他，咱们哪能有今天？”
众人纷纷点头，目光再次投向城门方向，尽管那里早已空无一人，只有风雪肆虐。
“方羽……他临走前提的那个剑庭……”
刀疤壮汉摸着下巴，若有所思，
“他说在天剑神州，建议咱们有机会可以去看看，加入进去。你们……有想法没？”
众人沉默了片刻。
一个一直没说话的沉稳青年开口道：
“我……考虑考虑吧。方兄的建议，总不会害我们。他说剑庭是个用剑的好去处……虽然咱们不知道剑庭到底是什么来头，但能让方兄特意提起，想必不差。而且……”
他环顾了一下周围的伙伴，又看了看这座冰冷而危险的飞雪城，
“在这神战坟场，咱们虽然混出了名堂，可终究是刀口舔血，脑袋别在裤腰带上。谁知道明天会不会就栽在哪次任务里？也许……是时候找个安稳点的靠山，换种活法了。”
他的话引起了众人的共鸣，大家望着风雪弥漫的城外，眼中既有对过往的不舍，也有对未来的迷茫与一丝微弱的憧憬。
“投票表决吧。同意去的举手。”
而在此时，那位刀疤壮汉举起手来沉声道。
随着刀疤壮汉话音落下，周围众人沉默了半晌，居然相继举起手来。
“好，既然如此，咱们就不干了，交付完这一次任务，便离开陨神古州，去天剑神州。”
刀疤壮汉见此脸上也露出了果决之色。
城外。
方羽的身影并未走远，他悬停于离地数丈的半空中，破旧的衣袍在凛冽寒风中猎猎作响。
他回望着飞雪城那高耸入云、伤痕累累的黑色城墙，如同匍匐在血色大地上的远古巨兽。
城墙上猎影佣兵团的战旗在狂风中顽强地舞动，猎猎之声仿佛伙伴们无声的送别。
他脸上露出一丝真诚而温暖的笑容，对着那巨城的方向，轻声自语，声音被呼啸的风雪瞬间卷走。
“诸位，期待再见。”
思绪，随着这声再见，飘回了遥远的过去。
当年与风云扬六人在神战坟场深处分别后，方羽便开始了独自一人的闯荡。
最初的几年，他如同孤狼，在危机四伏的古战场遗迹、煞气弥漫的险地中穿行，磨砺剑锋，感悟生死。
直到一次偶然，在被称为“噬骨荒原”的凶地边缘，他遇到了正被一群被煞气侵蚀、陷入疯狂的“血煞兽”围攻，濒临团灭的猎影小队。
那时的猎影，不过是个成立才几百年、成员实力参差不齐、在飞雪城都排不上号的小团队。
其中修为最高的队长刀疤，修为也不过是神主境四重巅峰。
还有三位神主境初期的成员，其余则是天神境巅峰到半步神主巅峰不等。
content_en:
The lean young man sighed again, and then a hint of sincere gratitude and pride appeared on his face.
"However, we are lucky to have him as a 'passing god'! For more than a hundred years, our shadow hunting mission completion rate is 100%! From the fifth level team to the first level, we have become a well-known signature of the Meteor God Ancient State, and Feixue City deserves to be number one! Without him, how could we be where we are today?"
Everyone nodded and looked towards the city gate again, even though there was no one there, only the wind and snow were raging.
"Fang Yu...the sword court he visited before leaving..."
The strong man with the scar touched his chin, thoughtfully.
"He said that he is in Tianjian Shenzhou, and suggested that we should go and have a look when we have the opportunity to join in. Do you... have any ideas?"
Everyone was silent for a moment.
A calm young man who had been silent until now said:
"I... think about it. Brother Fang's suggestion will never harm us. He said that Jianting is a good place to use swords... Although we don't know what the origin of Jianting is, it must be good if Brother Fang can mention it specifically. And..."
He looked around at his friends, and then at this cold and dangerous Feixue City.
"In this God War Cemetery, although we have made a name for ourselves, we are still licking blood with our heads in the waistband of our trousers. Who knows whether we will fall into a mission tomorrow? Maybe... it's time to find a more stable backer and change our way of life."
His words resonated with everyone. Everyone looked at the snow-filled city outside, with reluctance to let go of the past, confusion and a faint longing for the future.
"Let's vote. Those who agree to go raise their hands."
At this moment, the strong man with the scar raised his hand and said solemnly.
As the scarred man finished speaking, everyone around him was silent for a while, and then actually raised their hands one after another.
"Okay, in that case, let's quit. After delivering this mission, we will leave the Meteor God Ancient State and go to the Heavenly Sword State."
Seeing this, the strong man with the scar showed a look of determination on his face.
...
outside the city.
Fang Yu's figure had not gone far. He was hovering in mid-air several feet above the ground, his tattered robes rustling in the biting cold wind.
He looked back at Feixue City's towering, scarred black city wall, like an ancient behemoth crawling on the bloody earth.
The battle flag of the Shadow Hunter mercenary group on the city wall danced tenaciously in the strong wind, and the sound of Hunter Hunter was like a silent farewell from the partners.
With a sincere and warm smile on his face, he spoke softly to himself in the direction of the giant city, his voice instantly swept away by the howling wind and snow.
"Everyone, I look forward to seeing you again."
My thoughts, following this goodbye, drifted back to the distant past.
After parting ways with Fengyun Yang and the others deep in the Shenzhan Cemetery, Fang Yu began his adventure alone.
In the first few years, he was like a lone wolf, traveling through dangerous ancient battlefield ruins and dangerous areas filled with evil spirits, sharpening his sword and gaining insights into life and death.
Until by chance, on the edge of a dangerous land called the "Bone-Eating Wasteland", he encountered a shadow-hunting team that was on the verge of being destroyed by a group of "Blood Evil Beasts" who were eroded by evil spirits and fell into madness.
At that time, Hunting Shadow was just a small team that had only been established a few hundred years ago, with varying strengths among its members, and was not even ranked high in Feixue City.
Among them, Captain Scar, who has the highest level of cultivation, is only at the peak of the fourth level of the God Lord Realm.
There are also three members who are in the early stage of the God Lord Realm, and the rest are at the peak of the Heavenly God Realm to the half-step God Lord Realm.
